title: DIVINE PROTECTION
PSALM 23:4
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: golden light rays through thick forest canopy
ancient stone watchtower on quiet mountain peak
misty mountain pass at dawn aerial
calm lake water reflecting twilight sky
glowing embers in stone hearth warmth

scenes.a: The worry keeping you awake tonight has no power over the peace God intends for you.
Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
Father, cover this soul under your sovereign shadow in this hour of uncertainty and doubt.
Grant a steady spirit to navigate the path ahead and quiet the storms within their mind.
May they rest in the certainty that your presence is the anchor for every heavy step.
